claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Desoxycortone is a mineralocorticoid receptor agonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than to kill cells through a specific mechanism.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Desoxycortone is a mineralocorticoid receptor agonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than to kill cells through a specific mechanism.
